description: This Java class defines a response object for the 'ModifyThing' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates response details such as the Thing's ID, optional created Thing object, HTTP status, and headers. It also provides methods to create instances from JSON and to access response attributes.

classes.name: ModifyThingResponse
classes.description: A response object representing the outcome of a 'ModifyThing' command, including status, headers, and optionally the created or modified 'Thing' object.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a 'created' response with status 201, including the created 'Thing' object.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a 'modified' response with status 204, with specified Thing ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a response object from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing necessary fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing involved in the response.

methods.name: getThingCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created 'Thing', if available.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Produces a new response with updated headers.
